name: multiply_32bit_words
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values passed in the first two data registers using 16-bit partial products. The two cross products are added and shifted into the high word, then the low-by-low product is added, giving the low 32 bits of the result.

name: forward_string_library_call
description: On first use it sets a one-byte flag and makes an initialising library call. It then scans a null-terminated string and passes the register values and string pointer to a second library call, and the scan length is not used afterwards.

name: install_task_interrupt_handler
description: Looks up a task through an exec library call. If the task is found, it disables interrupts, passes a handler to another exec call, then re-enables interrupts; it returns 22 when the lookup fails.

name: copy_length_prefixed_string
description: Copies a length-prefixed string from the source address register into a fixed global buffer. It writes two zero bytes after the copied text and then passes control to the next routine.

name: copy_length_prefixed_file_name
description: Performs the same length-prefixed string copy into a fixed global buffer, adds two zero bytes at the end and makes two further calls. The routine refers to the text FILE1, so the copied string is most likely a file name.

name: poll_file_after_delay
description: Clears pending interrupt requests, enables interrupts and busy-waits for about one million loop iterations. It then makes library calls around the file text Zany:FILES/FILE1 and disables interrupts again before returning.

name: set_global_flag_to_255
description: Stores the value 255 into a single global byte and returns. It has no other effect.

name: run_handler_then_enable_interrupts
description: Calls a handler stored through a pointer and makes one exec library call. It then writes the saved interrupt bits with the set flag so interrupts are re-enabled, and returns the value held in a data register.

name: allocate_buffers_and_retry
description: Allocates a 12-byte control block and a 16000-byte buffer, returning 15 if either allocation fails, and returns 17 early when an initial check fails. It then retries an operation for each of three slots, giving up with status 18 after more than four errors, compares the collected values against thresholds of 50 and 300, frees both blocks and returns 16 or 18.

name: retry_loop_after_allocation
description: Allocates the same 12-byte control block and 16000-byte buffer, returning 15 if the first allocation fails, without the earlier check. It then runs the same three-slot retry loop, threshold comparisons and status selection, returning 16 or 18.

name: allocate_buffer_then_retry
description: Allocates a 16000-byte buffer and frees the earlier control block before returning 15 if that allocation fails. It then runs the same three-slot retry loop, threshold checks and cleanup, returning 16 or 18.

name: retry_loop_threshold_check
description: Runs the three-slot retry loop over an already prepared buffer, giving up with status 18 after more than four errors. It then compares the spread of collected values with thresholds of 50 and 300 to select status 16 or 18 and frees the buffers.

name: resume_retry_loop_check
description: Re-enters the same retry loop at a point after the buffers are set up, continuing the counting and error handling. When the loop finishes it runs the threshold comparison and cleanup, returning status 16 or 18.

name: record_value_and_retry
description: Sets a global flag to 1 and stores a returned value into the collected array, then keeps retrying with error counting. It returns 18 once more than four errors occur, and otherwise performs the same threshold and cleanup tail.

name: classify_value_spread_status
description: Compares the spread of collected values with thresholds of 50 and 300 to choose status 16 or 18. It sets that status, frees both buffers, makes a final cleanup call and returns.

name: select_status_from_difference
description: Sets status 18 when a stored difference is below 301 and status 16 otherwise. It then frees both buffers, makes the cleanup call and returns the status.

name: set_status_and_cleanup
description: Stores status 18, frees both buffers, makes the cleanup call and returns status 18.

name: release_buffers_return_status_18
description: Makes two cleanup calls, frees both buffers and returns status 18 with no other work.

name: scan_entries_until_flagged
description: Steps through indexed entries, calling a lookup routine for each one until it reports a flag of 1. It then returns a value built from the difference between two entry values with a fixed adjustment.

name: read_one_sector_trackdisk
description: Allocates an I/O request block and opens the trackdisk device, returning 1 if opening fails. On success it allocates a 512-byte buffer, reads one sector into it, turns the drive motor off, frees the request and buffer, and returns 0.

name: read_sector_into_buffer
description: Allocates a 512-byte buffer and reads one sector into it through the disk request, using an unnamed routine to obtain the target address. It then turns the drive motor off, deletes the request, frees the buffer and returns 0.

name: setup_disk_read_registers
description: Copies a 20-byte disk request template, sets one drive-select bit from the second argument, and writes the interrupt, DMA, ADKCON and MFM sync word registers to prepare a track read. It disables interrupts first and returns the current interrupt request and ADKCON register values.

name: set_interrupt_and_adkcon_bits
description: Sets the interrupt enable bits given in the upper half of its first argument and the ADKCON bits from its lower half, both as set operations. It stores the third argument in a fixed low-memory cell and then makes one call that passes on the lower half.

name: handshake_disk_control_bits
description: Clears one control bit and sets another in a shared control byte, then waits for the disk status input read from a CIA to change state. It sets a second control bit, waits for the status to change back, pauses for 15000 counts and returns.

name: wait_until_status_clears
description: Sets a control bit in the shared control byte, then busy-waits while the disk status input stays set. Once it clears, it pauses for 15000 counts and makes one more call with the request block.

name: delay_15000_then_call
description: Runs a 15000-count delay and then calls one routine with a value taken from the request block. The code is a short sequence with no other effect.

name: seek_drive_head_position
description: Compares a stored position with a requested one and returns 0 when they match. Otherwise it sets or clears a side bit and a direction bit in a shared control byte, issues the required step pulses with delays, updates the stored position and returns the result of a final call.

name: apply_side_and_step
description: Checks whether the stored position differs from the requested one in its parity bit and, if so, sets or clears a control bit and waits 200 counts. It then steps the position toward the requested value with delays, stores the new value and returns.

name: step_head_with_delay
description: Sets a control bit, waits 200 counts, then steps the position toward the requested value with delays. It stores the new value in the request block and returns.

name: step_to_position_and_store
description: Sets a direction control bit, computes the step count from the difference between two stored values and issues that many pulses with delays. It then pauses 15000 counts and stores the new position in the request block.

name: pause_then_store_position
description: Pauses 15000 counts, stores a requested value into the request block and makes a final call with that block.

name: combine_status_bytes_into_flags
description: Recomputes the shared control byte from two bytes at the argument address. It inverts the first byte and clears the high bit when the lowest bit of the second byte is set, while keeping the old high bit.

name: set_drive_control_bits
description: Sets bits 3 to 6 of a shared control byte and leaves the other bits unchanged. The routine is a single bit-set and returns.

name: busy_wait_quarter_count
description: Divides its argument by four and calls an unnamed routine once per remaining iteration, forming a busy-wait delay. The unnamed routine is a trivial routine with no effect of its own.

name: set_control_bit0_and_delay
description: Sets bit 0 in the shared control byte and leaves its other bits unchanged. It then waits 3000 counts through an unnamed routine.

name: read_disk_block_with_timeout
description: Writes the buffer pointer and a disk length word, clears the interrupt request for the disk block-done bit and polls that bit for up to 200000 tries. It returns 22 on timeout and otherwise clears the length register and returns 25 after cleanup.

name: poll_disk_block_done
description: Polls a status word up to a fixed count for a disk block-done flag. When the flag appears it clears the disk length register and returns status 25, or 22 when the poll runs out.

name: turn_on_motor_once
description: Sets a flag in the request block so the motor-on sequence runs only once. When the flag is clear it makes two unnamed routine calls with the block and waits 500000 counts.

name: set_motor_flag_and_wait
description: Sets a flag byte in the request block to 1, makes two unnamed routine calls with the block and waits 500000 counts. It is the same sequence as its neighbour without the once-only guard.

name: clear_motor_flag_and_call
description: If the flag byte in the request block is set, it clears the flag and makes two unnamed routine calls with the block. It does nothing when the flag is already clear.

name: clear_record_flag_and_notify
description: Clears the flag byte at offset 1 of the record named in the request block, then passes that record to an unnamed routine twice. It has no other effect.

name: find_sync_word_position
description: Scans 16-bit words from a start address, up to a given length, for the MFM sync word. It returns the address where the sector header begins, adjusted back by two or three words depending on whether a second sync word follows, or null when none is found.

name: return_frame_offset_minus_six
description: Returns the value stored in a frame slot minus six, used as a start position for a sector. It is a short unnamed routine with no other effect.

name: search_next_sync_word
description: Continues the sync-word search from the saved position, stepping two bytes at a time and returning null once the end is passed. When a sync word is found it returns the header start, adjusted in the same way as the main search.

name: encode_and_check_track_sectors
description: Writes the two preamble words and the sync word into a track buffer, stores a checksum from an unnamed routine, and processes up to eleven sector blocks. It returns 23 when no sector start is found, 24 when a checksum does not match, and 0 on success.

name: write_sector_headers_check
description: Chooses the header position from a sync-word check, writes the preamble and sync word into the track buffer and stores a checksum from an unnamed routine. It then loops over eleven sectors, returning 24 on a checksum mismatch and 23 when no sector start is found.

name: encode_sectors_after_sync_find
description: Writes the preamble and sync word six bytes before the stored frame position, stores a checksum, then finds the sector start and loops over eleven sectors checking checksums. It returns 23 when no sector start is found and 24 on a checksum mismatch.

name: check_sector_checksums_loop
description: Walks eleven sector entries, computing a checksum over 1024 bytes of each sector's data and comparing it with the stored checksum. It returns 24 on the first mismatch, and otherwise the stored status word.

name: verify_sector_data_checksums
description: Repeats the sector data checksum comparison over eleven entries and stops at the first sector whose two checksums differ. That case sets status 24, and the routine returns the status word.

name: return_stored_status
description: Returns the status value stored in the frame. It is the common exit used by the sector routines.

name: locate_sector_slot_for_index
description: Walks a table of fixed 1088-byte sector slots from a recorded base, advancing one slot per step, wrapping the index after 10 and switching to a stored alternate base when a count runs out. It returns the slot address for the requested index.

name: advance_sector_slot_pointer
description: Advances the slot pointer by one fixed-size slot per step, wrapping the index after 10 and switching to a stored alternate base when a counter runs out. It repeats until the index reaches the target and returns the slot address.

name: validate_sector_header_fields
description: Checks that a sector header has its sync word, two matching checksums, a marker byte of 255, the expected track, a sector index below 11 and a sector count from 1 to 11. It returns 4 for a missing sync word, 5 for a bad marker, 6 for a wrong track, 7 for a bad index, 8 for a bad count and 0 when the header is valid.

name: validate_header_against_request
description: Checks a sector header against the request block by comparing two checksums, the marker byte, the track number, the sector index and the sector count, returning 0 when all match. Failures return 5 through 8 in the same order as its neighbour, without the sync word check.

name: check_header_marker_track_sector
description: Checks the header marker byte, track number, sector index and sector count against the request block, returning 0 when all are valid. It returns 5 to 8 for the first failing field and skips the checksum comparison.

name: check_header_track_sector_count
description: Checks the track number, sector index and sector count of a header against the request block, returning 0 when valid. It returns 6 for a wrong track, 7 for a bad sector index and 8 for a bad count.

name: check_sector_index_and_count
description: Checks the sector index and sector count of a header, returning 0 when both are valid. It returns 7 for a bad index and 8 for a bad count.

name: check_sector_count_range
description: Checks that the header's sector count lies between 1 and 11, returning 0 when it does and 8 when it does not.

name: return_success_status
description: Returns 0 with no other work and serves as a success stub.

name: compute_masked_xor_checksum
description: XORs together the 32-bit words of a buffer, with the word count derived from the given byte length, then keeps only the alternate bit positions of the result. It returns the masked checksum used for disk sector data.

name: mask_frame_value_alternate_bits
description: Returns a value from a frame slot with only the alternate bit positions kept. It is a short masking unnamed routine with no other effect.

name: merge_odd_even_bit_halves
description: Combines two 32-bit words by keeping the alternate bits of the second word and shifting the alternate bits of the first word up by one. It returns the combined word, in the odd and even bit layout used for disk data.

name: create_standard_io_request
description: Creates an unnamed message port and stores it in the request block, then sets the request block size to 56 bytes. It has no other effect.

name: delete_standard_io_request
description: Deletes the message port stored in the request block, frees the 56-byte request block and returns 0.

name: read_sectors_via_io
description: Fills in a disk request to read a number of sectors from a given sector offset into a buffer, with byte offset and length derived from the sector numbers. It then performs the request and returns.

name: write_sectors_via_io
description: Fills in a disk request to write a number of sectors from a buffer at a given sector offset, with byte offset and length derived from the sector numbers. It then performs the request and returns.

name: format_sectors_via_io
description: Fills in a disk request to format a range of sectors and calls two unnamed routines first. It returns 1 or 2 if either unnamed routine reports a problem, and otherwise performs the request and returns its result.

name: check_then_do_io
description: Runs one unnamed routine check on the request and returns 2 if it reports a problem. Otherwise it performs the I/O request held in the stored block and returns the result.

name: perform_io_request
description: Performs the I/O request held in the stored block and returns. It has no other checks.

name: flush_disk_write_buffers
description: Sends the update command with zero offset and length, which flushes buffered disk writes, then performs the request.

name: turn_disk_motor_off
description: Fills in a disk request with the motor command and zero length and offset, then performs it, which turns the drive motor off.

name: query_disk_status_command
description: Sends a disk request with the given command code and zero offset and length, performs it, and returns the actual-count result stored in the request block.

name: create_message_port
description: Allocates a signal bit and a 34-byte message port, then sets its type, owner task and name fields from the current task. It adds the port to the public list or initialises its message list, and frees the signal and returns 0 if the port allocation fails.

name: allocate_port_for_signal
description: Allocates a 34-byte message port for an already allocated signal and initialises it the same way as its neighbour. It frees the signal and returns 0 if the allocation fails.

name: initialise_port_fields
description: Sets the owner task, signal, type and name fields of a message port, then adds the port to the public list or initialises its message list. It returns nothing.

name: initialise_list_header
description: Initialises an empty list header at a fixed offset inside the port structure, so that its head points to its tail.

name: delete_message_port
description: Removes the port from the public list when it has been added, marks its type and a field as deleted, frees its signal bit and releases the 34-byte port structure.

name: initialise_empty_list
description: Initialises an empty list header at the given address: the first pointer refers to the tail slot inside the header, the tail is cleared and the last pointer refers back to the header.

name: return_status_16
description: Returns the constant 16 and does nothing else. It is a runtime segment stub.

description: Checks that a sector header has its sync word, two matching checksums, a marker byte of 255, the expected track, a sector index below 11 and a sector count from 1 to 11. It returns 4 for a missing sync word, 5 for a bad marker, 6 for a wrong track, 7 for a bad index, 8 for a bad count and 0 when the header is valid.

name: validate_header_against_request
description: Checks a sector header against the request block by comparing two checksums, the marker byte, the track number, the sector index and the sector count, returning 0 when all match. Failures return 5 through 8 in the same order as its neighbour, without the sync word check.

name: check_header_marker_track_sector
description: Checks the header marker byte, track number, sector index and sector count against the request block, returning 0 when all are valid. It returns 5 to 8 for the first failing field and skips the checksum comparison.

name: check_header_track_sector_count
description: Checks the track number, sector index and sector count of a header against the request block, returning 0 when valid. It returns 6 for a wrong track, 7 for a bad sector index and 8 for a bad count.

name: check_sector_index_and_count
description: Checks the sector index and sector count of a header, returning 0 when both are valid. It returns 7 for a bad index and 8 for a bad count.

name: check_sector_count_range
description: Checks that the header's sector count lies between 1 and 11, returning 0 when it does and 8 when it does not.

name: return_success_status
description: Returns 0 with no other work and serves as a success stub.

name: compute_masked_xor_checksum
description: XORs together the 32-bit words of a buffer, with the word count derived from the given byte length, then keeps only the alternate bit positions of the result. It returns the masked checksum used for disk sector data.

name: mask_frame_value_alternate_bits
description: Returns a value from a frame slot with only the alternate bit positions kept. It is a short masking unnamed routine with no other effect.

name: merge_odd_even_bit_halves
description: Combines two 32-bit words by keeping the alternate bits of the second word and shifting the alternate bits of the first word up by one. It returns the combined word, in the odd and even bit layout used for disk data.

name: create_standard_io_request
description: Creates an unnamed message port and stores it in the request block, then sets the request block size to 56 bytes. It has no other effect.

name: delete_standard_io_request
description: Deletes the message port stored in the request block, frees the 56-byte request block and returns 0.

name: read_sectors_via_io
description: Fills in a disk request to read a number of sectors from a given sector offset into a buffer, with byte offset and length derived from the sector numbers. It then performs the request and returns.

name: write_sectors_via_io
description: Fills in a disk request to write a number of sectors from a buffer at a given sector offset, with byte offset and length derived from the sector numbers. It then performs the request and returns.

name: format_sectors_via_io
description: Fills in a disk request to format a range of sectors and calls two unnamed routines first. It returns 1 or 2 if either unnamed routine reports a problem, and otherwise performs the request and returns its result.

name: check_then_do_io
description: Runs one unnamed routine check on the request and returns 2 if it reports a problem. Otherwise it performs the I/O request held in the stored block and returns the result.

name: perform_io_request
description: Performs the I/O request held in the stored block and returns. It has no other checks.

name: flush_disk_write_buffers
description: Sends the update command with zero offset and length, which flushes buffered disk writes, then performs the request.

name: turn_disk_motor_off
description: Fills in a disk request with the motor command and zero length and offset, then performs it, which turns the drive motor off.

name: query_disk_status_command
description: Sends a disk request with the given command code and zero offset and length, performs it, and returns the actual-count result stored in the request block.

name: create_message_port
description: Allocates a signal bit and a 34-byte message port, then sets its type, owner task and name fields from the current task. It adds the port to the public list or initialises its message list, and frees the signal and returns 0 if the port allocation fails.

name: allocate_port_for_signal
description: Allocates a 34-byte message port for an already allocated signal and initialises it the same way as its neighbour. It frees the signal and returns 0 if the allocation fails.

name: initialise_port_fields
description: Sets the owner task, signal, type and name fields of a message port, then adds the port to the public list or initialises its message list. It returns nothing.

name: initialise_list_header
description: Initialises an empty list header at a fixed offset inside the port structure, so that its head points to its tail.

name: delete_message_port
description: Removes the port from the public list when it has been added, marks its type and a field as deleted, frees its signal bit and releases the 34-byte port structure.

name: initialise_empty_list
description: Initialises an empty list header at the given address: the first pointer refers to the tail slot inside the header, the tail is cleared and the last pointer refers back to the header.

name: return_status_16
description: Returns the constant 16 and does nothing else. It is a runtime segment stub.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[a2]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[a2].adf:files/FILE1 (raw code file, load address unknown):0:0000
name: store_args_and_call_pointer
description: Stores its stack argument and an address register value into fixed memory cells, then makes an indirect call through a pointer held in memory. The routine is a raw code entry in the FILE1 segment and its jump target is not recovered.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[a2]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[a2].adf:files/FILE1 (raw code file, load address unknown):0:0C42
name: stub_unresolved_indirect_call
description: The decompiled body is only one indirect call through a table pointer whose target was not recovered. The register use listed in the facts (audio volumes, DMA and ADKCON) belongs to the full routine and cannot be confirmed from this pseudo-code.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:type:0:0136
name: copy_context_words_then_call
description: If the output pointer argument is not null, it copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset in the context block into that pointer. It then makes an indirect call through a pointer held in the address register.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:0000
name: check_original_disk_then_run
description: Program entry point that opens a library and checks the disk signature with an unnamed routine, waiting on the disk status input when the original disk must be inserted and showing a message asking for it. It then installs a handler through an exec call, runs the main code through a stored pointer, restores interrupts and returns a status.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:0134
name: divide_signed_32bit
description: Divides one signed 32-bit value by another using normalised 16-bit steps and a correction step. It calls an unsigned division unnamed routine for negative operands and negates the result as needed.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:014C
name: negate_division_result
description: Calls a division unnamed routine and returns its 64-bit result with both halves negated. It serves as the signed wrapper around that unnamed routine.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:0156
name: divide_unsigned_32bit_quotient
description: Computes the unsigned quotient of a 32-bit dividend and divisor using normalised 16-bit steps and a single correction step, returning only the quotient. It calls an unnamed routine and negates the result when the divisor is negative.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:0166
name: divide_unsigned_quotient_remainder
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit value by another using normalised steps, returning the 16-bit quotient and the remainder packed into one result. The quotient is corrected by one when the partial product is too large.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:0190
name: divide_32_by_16_normalised
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by the low 16 bits of the divisor after normalising the divisor, returning a 16-bit quotient and the remainder packed together. It makes no check for a zero high word.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:01F6
name: multiply_32bit_words
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values passed in the first two data registers using 16-bit partial products. The two cross products are added and shifted into the high word, then the low-by-low product is added, giving the low 32 bits of the result.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:02AE
name: forward_string_library_call
description: On first use it sets a one-byte flag and makes an initialising library call. It then scans a null-terminated string and passes the register values and string pointer to a second library call, and the scan length is not used afterwards.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:0490
name: install_task_interrupt_handler
description: Looks up a task through an exec library call. If the task is found, it disables interrupts, passes a handler to another exec call, then re-enables interrupts; it returns 22 when the lookup fails.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:052E
name: copy_length_prefixed_string
description: Copies a length-prefixed string from the source address register into a fixed global buffer. It writes two zero bytes after the copied text and then passes control to the next routine.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:0572
name: copy_length_prefixed_file_name
description: Performs the same length-prefixed string copy into a fixed global buffer, adds two zero bytes at the end and makes two further calls. The routine refers to the text FILE1, so the copied string is most likely a file name.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:05AA
name: poll_file_after_delay
description: Clears pending interrupt requests, enables interrupts and busy-waits for about one million loop iterations. It then makes library calls around the file text Zany:FILES/FILE1 and disables interrupts again before returning.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:062E
name: set_global_flag_to_255
description: Stores the value 255 into a single global byte and returns. It has no other effect.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:0:064A
name: run_handler_then_enable_interrupts
description: Calls a handler stored through a pointer and makes one exec library call. It then writes the saved interrupt bits with the set flag so interrupts are re-enabled, and returns the value held in a data register.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0004
name: allocate_buffers_and_retry
description: Allocates a 12-byte control block and a 16000-byte buffer, returning 15 if either allocation fails, and returns 17 early when an initial check fails. It then retries an operation for each of three slots, giving up with status 18 after more than four errors, compares the collected values against thresholds of 50 and 300, frees both blocks and returns 16 or 18.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0020
name: retry_loop_after_allocation
description: Allocates the same 12-byte control block and 16000-byte buffer, returning 15 if the first allocation fails, without the earlier check. It then runs the same three-slot retry loop, threshold comparisons and status selection, returning 16 or 18.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0040
name: allocate_buffer_then_retry
description: Allocates a 16000-byte buffer and frees the earlier control block before returning 15 if that allocation fails. It then runs the same three-slot retry loop, threshold checks and cleanup, returning 16 or 18.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0072
name: retry_loop_threshold_check
description: Runs the three-slot retry loop over an already prepared buffer, giving up with status 18 after more than four errors. It then compares the spread of collected values with thresholds of 50 and 300 to select status 16 or 18 and frees the buffers.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:00F4
name: resume_retry_loop_check
description: Re-enters the same retry loop at a point after the buffers are set up, continuing the counting and error handling. When the loop finishes it runs the threshold comparison and cleanup, returning status 16 or 18.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:011E
name: record_value_and_retry
description: Sets a global flag to 1 and stores a returned value into the collected array, then keeps retrying with error counting. It returns 18 once more than four errors occur, and otherwise performs the same threshold and cleanup tail.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:015C
name: classify_value_spread_status
description: Compares the spread of collected values with thresholds of 50 and 300 to choose status 16 or 18. It sets that status, frees both buffers, makes a final cleanup call and returns.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:01F8
name: select_status_from_difference
description: Sets status 18 when a stored difference is below 301 and status 16 otherwise. It then frees both buffers, makes the cleanup call and returns the status.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0216
name: set_status_and_cleanup
description: Stores status 18, frees both buffers, makes the cleanup call and returns status 18.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0274
name: release_buffers_return_status_18
description: Makes two cleanup calls, frees both buffers and returns status 18 with no other work.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:02B8
name: scan_entries_until_flagged
description: Steps through indexed entries, calling a lookup routine for each one until it reports a flag of 1. It then returns a value built from the difference between two entry values with a fixed adjustment.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:033A
name: read_one_sector_trackdisk
description: Allocates an I/O request block and opens the trackdisk device, returning 1 if opening fails. On success it allocates a 512-byte buffer, reads one sector into it, turns the drive motor off, frees the request and buffer, and returns 0.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0396
name: read_sector_into_buffer
description: Allocates a 512-byte buffer and reads one sector into it through the disk request, using an unnamed routine to obtain the target address. It then turns the drive motor off, deletes the request, frees the buffer and returns 0.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0406
name: setup_disk_read_registers
description: Copies a 20-byte disk request template, sets one drive-select bit from the second argument, and writes the interrupt, DMA, ADKCON and MFM sync word registers to prepare a track read. It disables interrupts first and returns the current interrupt request and ADKCON register values.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:04B2
name: set_interrupt_and_adkcon_bits
description: Sets the interrupt enable bits given in the upper half of its first argument and the ADKCON bits from its lower half, both as set operations. It stores the third argument in a fixed low-memory cell and then makes one call that passes on the lower half.

key: zany golf (1988)(electronic arts)[h born to win]/Zany Golf (1988)(Electronic Arts)[h Born to Win].adf:Zany:1:0512
name: handshake_disk_control_bits
description: Clears one control bit and sets another in a shared control byte, then waits for the disk status input read from a CIA to change state. It sets a second control bit, waits for the status to change back, pauses for 15000 counts and returns.
